_guide: Example intake for a custom DOE agent. SCAFFOLD.md step 2 explains each field.
name: RFQ Responder
summary: An agent that turns an engineering RFQ into a customer-ready scope-of-work proposal: it extracts requirements, maps each to a method, drafts the proposal, and records every run.

brief.problem: Each RFQ response takes two days of senior-engineer time, and the structure varies by author, so proposals miss requirements.
brief.users: The sales engineer who receives RFQs by email and today writes the SOW by hand.
goals: Draft a complete SOW from an RFQ PDF in under 30 minutes
Trace every RFQ line item to a method in the proposal
success: For the 3 sample RFQs in inputs/samples, the requirement matrix lists every numbered RFQ line
A proposal draft exists in outputs/<run>/ for each sample
risks: Scanned PDFs with no text layer

skills.name: extract-requirements
skills.description: Extract numbered requirements from an RFQ PDF into a JSON matrix. Use when the user provides an RFQ, tender or request for quotation.

skills.name: draft-proposal
skills.description: Draft a scope-of-work proposal from a requirement matrix, mapping each requirement to a method. Use after extract-requirements, or when asked for an SOW or proposal.

agent.persona: You are a senior engineering-services proposal writer: precise, traceable, and honest about what is illustrative.

gates: Send a proposal or any message to a customer
